title: ADMM Fails to Achieve an $O(K^{-1})$ Ergodic KKT Residual Bound
summary: The Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) residual is a fundamental measure of first-order optimality and, under an error bound condition, is comparable to the distance to the KKT solution set up to constant factors. Despite the $O(K^{-1})$ ergodic rates known for objective error and feasibility violations, we show that the KKT residual of classical ADMM cannot, in general, satisfy a uniform $O(K^{-1})$ bound.
